name.en-US: Question of the Water and the Land (Quaestio de aqua et terra)
name.pt-BR: Questão sobre a água e a terra (Quaestio de aqua et terra)

description.la: Quaestio de aqua et terra, a Dante Veronae disputata die 20 ianuarii 1320: de forma et situ duorum elementorum aque videlicet et terre, an aqua in sua sphaera esset altior terra. Opus unico typo anni 1508 servatum; plures auctoritatem receperunt.
description.en-US: Dante’s academic disputation at Verona on 20 January 1320 on the form and position of the two elements, water and earth: whether water in its sphere stands higher than the land. The work survives only in a Venice print of 1508 and its authenticity was long debated; most scholars now accept it. Text of La Wikisource.
description.pt-BR: A disputa acadêmica de Dante em Verona, a 20 de janeiro de 1320, sobre a forma e a posição dos dois elementos, a água e a terra. O texto só se conservou numa edição veneziana de 1508; hoje a maioria dos estudiosos aceita a sua autenticidade.

sources.edition: Quaestio de aqua et terra on La Wikisource.
sources.description: The whole text as one chapter; the wiki markup is dropped. Paragraph numbering is not in this transcription. The English of Wicksteed (1904) and A. C. White (1903) is OCR only and is not imported.
sources.tierEvidence: Medieval text; La Wikisource transcription, quality marked 25%.
